subhero.en: South Carolina Healthy Connections Medicaid covers pregnant women with incomes up to 194% of the Federal Poverty Level and enrolls year-round with no deadline. Most pregnant women in SC qualify for free coverage before checking Marketplace options.
subhero.es: Healthy Connections de Carolina del Sur cubre a mujeres embarazadas con ingresos hasta el 194% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza e inscribe todo el año sin fecha limite. La mayoria de mujeres embarazadas en SC califica para cobertura gratuita antes de revisar opciones del Mercado.

heading.en: You can apply for South Carolina Healthy Connections Medicaid year-round, no deadline
heading.es: Puede solicitar Healthy Connections de Carolina del Sur todo el año, sin fecha limite

body.en: South Carolina Healthy Connections Medicaid for pregnant women is not tied to Open Enrollment. Apply any day at apply.scdhhs.gov or call 1-888-549-0820. Presumptive Eligibility can start temporary prenatal coverage within days while your full application is reviewed. Once enrolled, your coverage continues for 12 months after delivery under the postpartum extension South Carolina adopted in 2022. The only time-sensitive clock for pregnant women in SC involves the ACA Marketplace: if you do not qualify for Healthy Connections and you have a baby, the birth triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period at healthcare.gov.
body.es: Healthy Connections de Carolina del Sur para mujeres embarazadas no esta vinculado a la Inscripcion Abierta. Solicite cualquier dia en apply.scdhhs.gov o llame al 1-888-549-0820. La Elegibilidad Presuntiva puede iniciar cobertura prenatal temporal en dias mientras se revisa su solicitud completa. Una vez inscrita, su cobertura continua por 12 meses despues del parto. El unico reloj urgente para mujeres embarazadas en SC que involucra el Mercado ACA: si no califica para Healthy Connections y tiene un bebe, el nacimiento activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias en healthcare.gov.

quickAnswer.en: Pregnant women in South Carolina can apply for Healthy Connections Medicaid any time of year, no Open Enrollment deadline. South Carolina covers pregnant women at incomes up to 194% of the Federal Poverty Level, which equals approximately $30,962 per year for a household of 1 or $53,001 for a household of 3 (counting the unborn child) in 2026. South Carolina has NOT expanded Medicaid for non-pregnant adults under the ACA, so if your income is above the 194% FPL pregnancy limit, your next option is an ACA Marketplace plan through healthcare.gov with a premium tax credit. Children qualify for Healthy Connections Kids (CHIP) at incomes up to 200% FPL year-round. After the birth, South Carolina extends your Healthy Connections postpartum coverage for 12 months, and your newborn is automatically enrolled in Medicaid through age 1.
quickAnswer.es: Las mujeres embarazadas en Carolina del Sur pueden solicitar Healthy Connections Medicaid en cualquier momento del año, sin fecha limite de Inscripcion Abierta. Carolina del Sur cubre a las mujeres embarazadas con ingresos hasta el 194% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, que equivale a aproximadamente $30,962 al año para un hogar de 1 o $53,001 para un hogar de 3 (contando al nonato) en 2026. Carolina del Sur NO ha expandido Medicaid para adultos no embarazados bajo la ACA. Si su ingreso supera el limite del 194% FPL de embarazo, su proxima opcion es un plan del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov con credito fiscal de prima. Los niños califican para Healthy Connections Kids (CHIP) con ingresos hasta el 200% FPL todo el año.

introParagraphs.en: Pregnancy in South Carolina opens coverage pathways that do not exist for most non-pregnant adults in the state. South Carolina is one of 10 states that has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA, which means adults without children typically face a coverage gap if their income falls under 100% of the Federal Poverty Level without qualifying for standard Medicaid. Pregnancy changes the calculation entirely. South Carolina's Healthy Connections Medicaid program, administered by the South Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (SCDHHS), covers pregnant women at incomes up to 194% of the Federal Poverty Level regardless of the state's non-expansion status. For 2026, 194% FPL equals approximately $30,962 per year for a household of 1. Critically, most states and SCDHHS count the unborn child as a household member starting from pregnancy, which raises your household size by 1 and lifts the applicable income threshold in your favor. A pregnant woman counting herself plus the unborn child as a household of 2 qualifies at 194% FPL up to approximately $41,982 per year in 2026. South Carolina also adopted the 12-month postpartum Medicaid extension in 2022, meaning your Healthy Connections coverage continues for a full year after the baby is born. Your newborn is automatically enrolled in Healthy Connections through their first birthday under the deemed newborn rule.
introParagraphs.es: El embarazo en Carolina del Sur abre vias de cobertura que no existen para la mayoria de adultos no embarazados en el estado. Carolina del Sur es uno de los 10 estados que no ha expandido Medicaid bajo la ACA, lo que significa que los adultos sin hijos tipicamente enfrentan una brecha de cobertura. El embarazo cambia el calculo por completo. El programa Healthy Connections Medicaid de Carolina del Sur, administrado por el Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos de Carolina del Sur (SCDHHS), cubre a las mujeres embarazadas con ingresos hasta el 194% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza independientemente del estado de no expansion del estado. Para 2026, el 194% FPL equivale a aproximadamente $30,962 al año para un hogar de 1. La mayoria de los estados y SCDHHS cuentan al nonato como miembro del hogar desde el embarazo, lo que eleva el tamaño del hogar en 1 y sube el umbral de ingresos aplicable a su favor. Carolina del Sur tambien adopto la extension de Medicaid posparto de 12 meses en 2022, lo que significa que su cobertura Healthy Connections continua durante un año completo despues del parto.

introParagraphs.en: Three coverage pathways are available for pregnant women in South Carolina in 2026. First, Healthy Connections Medicaid at 194% FPL: free or near-free, year-round enrollment, no deadline, comprehensive prenatal care including labor and delivery with zero cost-sharing in most cases. Second, for women above the 194% FPL pregnancy limit, ACA Marketplace plans through healthcare.gov cover maternity care as a required essential health benefit, with premium tax credits available between 100% FPL and 400% FPL in 2026. The 2026 ACA Marketplace out-of-pocket maximum is $10,600 per individual, meaning Marketplace coverage carries significantly more cost-sharing than Healthy Connections for delivery. Third, CHIP through the Healthy Connections Kids program covers children at incomes up to 200% FPL and covers the unborn child through CHIP Perinatal if the mother does not qualify for full pregnancy Medicaid. Applying at apply.scdhhs.gov or through healthcare.gov starts the eligibility determination process and routes you to the correct program. South Carolina processes MAGI-based applications including pregnancy Medicaid in up to 45 days; Presumptive Eligibility can start temporary prenatal coverage within days while the full application is pending. Apply immediately and do not wait until the third trimester.
introParagraphs.es: Tres vias de cobertura estan disponibles para mujeres embarazadas en Carolina del Sur en 2026. Primero, Healthy Connections Medicaid al 194% FPL: gratuito o casi gratuito, inscripcion todo el año, sin fecha limite, atencion prenatal integral incluyendo parto y alumbramiento con cero costo compartido en la mayoria de los casos. Segundo, para mujeres por encima del limite del 194% FPL, los planes del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov cubren la atencion de maternidad como beneficio esencial obligatorio, con creditos fiscales de prima disponibles entre 100% FPL y 400% FPL en 2026. El maximo de gastos de bolsillo del Mercado ACA 2026 es $10,600 por persona. Tercero, CHIP a traves del programa Healthy Connections Kids cubre a niños con ingresos hasta el 200% FPL. Aplicar en apply.scdhhs.gov o a traves de healthcare.gov inicia el proceso de determinacion de elegibilidad.

name.en: Count your household size correctly, including the unborn child
name.es: Cuente correctamente el tamaño de su hogar, incluyendo al nonato

text.en: South Carolina Healthy Connections counts the unborn child as a household member for Medicaid eligibility purposes. If you are a single pregnant woman, apply as a household of 2 rather than 1. This raises your income threshold in your favor: at 194% FPL, a household of 2 qualifies up to approximately $41,982 per year in 2026 vs. $30,962 for a household of 1. Incorrect household size is the most common reason applications are processed at a less favorable threshold.
text.es: Healthy Connections de Carolina del Sur cuenta al nonato como miembro del hogar para propositos de elegibilidad de Medicaid. Si es una mujer embarazada soltera, solicite como hogar de 2 en lugar de 1. Esto eleva su umbral de ingresos a su favor: al 194% FPL, un hogar de 2 califica hasta aproximadamente $41,982 al año en 2026 en lugar de $30,962 para un hogar de 1.

name.en: Check Healthy Connections income eligibility at 194% FPL
name.es: Verifique la elegibilidad de ingresos de Healthy Connections al 194% FPL

text.en: South Carolina covers pregnant women through Healthy Connections at incomes up to 194% of the Federal Poverty Level. Calculate your projected 2026 Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI). For a household of 2 (pregnant woman plus unborn child) in 2026, 194% FPL is approximately $41,982. For a household of 3, it is approximately $53,001. If your MAGI falls under your household's 194% FPL threshold, apply immediately at apply.scdhhs.gov or call SCDHHS at 1-888-549-0820. Healthy Connections enrollment is year-round with no deadline.
text.es: Carolina del Sur cubre a las mujeres embarazadas a traves de Healthy Connections con ingresos hasta el 194% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Calcule su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado para 2026. Para un hogar de 2 (mujer embarazada mas nonato) en 2026, el 194% FPL es aproximadamente $41,982. Para un hogar de 3, es aproximadamente $53,001. Si su MAGI cae bajo el umbral del 194% FPL de su hogar, solicite de inmediato en apply.scdhhs.gov o llame al 1-888-549-0820.

name.en: Apply for Presumptive Eligibility to start prenatal coverage within days
name.es: Solicite Elegibilidad Presuntiva para iniciar cobertura prenatal en dias

text.en: South Carolina offers Presumptive Eligibility (PE) for pregnant women, which provides temporary coverage for outpatient prenatal services while your full Healthy Connections application is reviewed. A qualified entity such as a hospital, prenatal clinic, or federally qualified health center can authorize a two-month PE period for prenatal care. Note that PE coverage does NOT include labor and delivery; only the full Healthy Connections approval covers the birth. Ask your prenatal provider or SCDHHS at 1-888-549-0820 to initiate PE so your prenatal visits are covered immediately.
text.es: Carolina del Sur ofrece Elegibilidad Presuntiva (PE) para mujeres embarazadas, que proporciona cobertura temporal para servicios prenatales ambulatorios mientras se revisa su solicitud completa de Healthy Connections. Una entidad calificada como un hospital, clinica prenatal o centro de salud calificado federalmente puede autorizar un periodo de PE de dos meses para atencion prenatal. Tenga en cuenta que la cobertura de PE NO incluye el parto; solo la aprobacion completa de Healthy Connections cubre el nacimiento.

name.en: Submit your Healthy Connections application with required documents
name.es: Envie su solicitud de Healthy Connections con los documentos requeridos

text.en: Apply online at apply.scdhhs.gov, by calling 1-888-549-0820, or in person at your county SCDHHS office. Submit a doctor or midwife letter confirming pregnancy and estimated due date, proof of income (last 30 days of pay stubs or employer letter), proof of South Carolina residency (utility bill or lease), your Social Security number, and a government-issued photo ID. SCDHHS processes MAGI-based pregnancy Medicaid applications in up to 45 days. Coverage can be retroactive to the first day of the month you applied.
text.es: Solicite en linea en apply.scdhhs.gov, llamando al 1-888-549-0820, o en persona en su oficina SCDHHS del condado. Envie una carta de su medico o partera que confirme el embarazo y la fecha estimada de parto, prueba de ingresos (talones de pago de los ultimos 30 dias o carta del empleador), prueba de residencia en Carolina del Sur, su numero de Seguro Social y una identificacion con foto emitida por el gobierno. SCDHHS procesa solicitudes de Medicaid de embarazo basadas en MAGI en hasta 45 dias. La cobertura puede ser retroactiva al primer dia del mes en que solicito.

name.en: If above 194% FPL, enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov
name.es: Si supera el 194% FPL, inscribase en un plan del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov

text.en: South Carolina uses the federally-facilitated Marketplace at healthcare.gov. If your income exceeds the 194% FPL Healthy Connections pregnancy threshold, compare ACA plans using your correct household size and projected 2026 income. ACA Marketplace plans are required to cover maternity care and prenatal services as essential health benefits. Premium tax credits (Crédito Fiscal de Prima) reduce your monthly cost if your income is between 100% FPL and 400% FPL in 2026. Becoming pregnant is a qualifying life event that opens a 60-day Special Enrollment Period if you do not already have Marketplace coverage, so apply within 60 days of confirming your pregnancy.
text.es: Carolina del Sur usa el Mercado de facilitar federal en healthcare.gov. Si su ingreso supera el umbral Healthy Connections de embarazo del 194% FPL, compare planes ACA usando el tamaño correcto de su hogar e ingresos proyectados 2026. Los planes del Mercado ACA deben cubrir la atencion de maternidad y los servicios prenatales como beneficios esenciales de salud. Los creditos fiscales de prima reducen su costo mensual si su ingreso esta entre el 100% FPL y el 400% FPL en 2026.

name.en: Confirm your 12-month postpartum Healthy Connections coverage continues
name.es: Confirme que su cobertura Healthy Connections posparto de 12 meses continua

text.en: South Carolina adopted the 12-month postpartum Medicaid extension, meaning your Healthy Connections coverage continues for 12 months after delivery under the same pregnancy category without a new income determination. Ask your SCDHHS caseworker to confirm your postpartum coverage start and end dates when you receive your approval letter. After the 12-month postpartum period ends, standard South Carolina Medicaid income rules apply, and most non-pregnant adults above the very low SC income thresholds for standard Medicaid will not qualify unless they are parents of minor children or have a disability. Losing Medicaid postpartum triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for healthcare.gov Marketplace plans.
text.es: Carolina del Sur adopto la extension de Medicaid posparto de 12 meses, lo que significa que su cobertura Healthy Connections continua por 12 meses despues del parto bajo la misma categoria de embarazo sin una nueva determinacion de ingresos. Pregunte a su trabajador de casos de SCDHHS para confirmar las fechas de inicio y fin de su cobertura posparto cuando reciba su carta de aprobacion. Despues de que termina el periodo posparto de 12 meses, se aplican las reglas de ingresos de Medicaid estandar de Carolina del Sur.

name.en: Confirm your newborn is enrolled in Healthy Connections through age 1
name.es: Confirme que su recien nacido este inscrito en Healthy Connections hasta los 12 meses

text.en: Babies born to mothers enrolled in Healthy Connections on the delivery date are automatically deemed eligible for South Carolina Medicaid through their first birthday under the federal deemed newborn rule (42 U.S.C. 1396a(e)(4)). No separate application is required for the baby. Notify SCDHHS of the baby's name and birth date within 60 days to finalize the enrollment record. After the baby's first birthday, apply for Healthy Connections Kids (CHIP) at incomes up to 200% FPL to continue children's coverage without a gap.
text.es: Los bebes nacidos de madres inscritas en Healthy Connections el dia del parto son automaticamente considerados elegibles para Medicaid de Carolina del Sur hasta su primer cumpleanos bajo la regla federal del recien nacido considerado (42 U.S.C. 1396a(e)(4)). No se requiere solicitud separada para el bebe. Notifique a SCDHHS el nombre y fecha de nacimiento del bebe dentro de 60 dias para finalizar el registro de inscripcion.

footnote.en: South Carolina (Healthy Connections) 2026 pregnancy Medicaid limit is 194% FPL. SC has not expanded standard adult Medicaid under the ACA; pregnancy Medicaid and CHIP are separate from the expansion. The 2026 ACA Marketplace OOP maximum is $10,600 per individual (HHS 2026 NBPP). ACA subsidy cliff returned for 2026 after enhanced PTCs expired January 1, 2026: subsidies are available from 100% to 400% FPL.

en: Proof of pregnancy: signed letter or document from a licensed physician, OB-GYN, nurse practitioner, or certified nurse midwife confirming pregnancy and estimated due date (required for both Healthy Connections Medicaid and ACA Marketplace SEP)
Proof of South Carolina residency: utility bill, lease agreement, mortgage statement, or official government mail addressed to you in SC
Proof of identity: government-issued photo ID (SC driver's license, state ID card, US passport, or passport card)
Social Security numbers for all household members applying (or proof of pending Social Security application if not yet issued)
Proof of income: last 30 days of pay stubs, employer letter showing wages, most recent federal tax return (Form 1040), or a signed statement of no income if currently unemployed

Immigration status documents if not a US citizen: green card, visa, Employment Authorization Document, or other lawful presence proof (lawfully present immigrants qualify for SC pregnancy Medicaid in most cases)
Proof of current insurance, if any: insurance card, COBRA election notice, or employer benefits summary (needed to document qualifying event for Marketplace SEP)
1095-A form from a prior Marketplace plan, if applicable, to verify existing coverage period
es: Prueba de embarazo: carta firmada o documento de un medico, OB-GYN, enfermera practicante o partera certificada con licencia que confirme el embarazo y la fecha estimada de parto
Prueba de residencia en Carolina del Sur: factura de servicios, contrato de arrendamiento, estado de cuenta hipotecario o correspondencia oficial del gobierno dirigida a usted en SC
Prueba de identidad: identificacion con foto emitida por el gobierno (licencia de conducir de SC, tarjeta de identificacion estatal, pasaporte de EE.UU. o tarjeta de pasaporte)
Numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan (o prueba de solicitud de Seguro Social pendiente si aun no se ha emitido)

Prueba de ingresos: talones de pago de los ultimos 30 dias, carta del empleador mostrando salarios, declaracion de impuestos federal mas reciente (Formulario 1040), o declaracion firmada de no ingresos si esta desempleada actualmente
Documentos de estado migratorio si no es ciudadana estadounidense: tarjeta verde, visa, Documento de Autorizacion de Empleo u otra prueba de presencia legal
Prueba de seguro actual, si tiene alguno: tarjeta de seguro, aviso de eleccion de COBRA o resumen de beneficios del empleador
Formulario 1095-A de un plan del Mercado anterior, si aplica, para verificar el periodo de cobertura existente

en: Applying as a household of 1 instead of 2: South Carolina counts the unborn child as a household member, which raises the income threshold. A single pregnant woman should apply as a household of 2, giving herself a higher 194% FPL ceiling.

Submitting proof of pregnancy that is not a signed clinical document: a home pregnancy test or pharmacy receipt does not satisfy SCDHHS documentation requirements. A dated letter from your OB-GYN or midwife with estimated due date is required.

Reporting gross income instead of MAGI: South Carolina Healthy Connections uses Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI). Self-employment income after business expenses and certain deductions may be lower than gross receipts. Using the wrong figure can push income above the 194% FPL limit.

Applying to standard adult Medicaid instead of the pregnancy category: standard SC Medicaid for non-pregnant adults covers a very small population (parents below approximately 67% FPL). Pregnant women must specify the pregnancy category at apply.scdhhs.gov or SCDHHS will route the application incorrectly.

Missing the residency requirement after a recent move: Healthy Connections requires current South Carolina residency. Women who recently moved from another state must establish SC residency before applying. Contact SCDHHS at 1-888-549-0820 if you need help transferring Medicaid coverage from another state.
es: Solicitar como hogar de 1 en lugar de 2: Carolina del Sur cuenta al nonato como miembro del hogar, lo que eleva el umbral de ingresos. Una mujer embarazada soltera debe solicitar como hogar de 2, dandose un techo del 194% FPL mas alto.

Presentar prueba de embarazo que no es un documento clinico firmado: una prueba de embarazo casera o recibo de farmacia no satisface los requisitos de documentacion de SCDHHS. Se requiere una carta con fecha de su OB-GYN o partera con la fecha estimada de parto.

Reportar ingreso bruto en lugar de MAGI: Healthy Connections de Carolina del Sur usa el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI). Los ingresos del trabajo por cuenta propia despues de los gastos empresariales pueden ser mas bajos que los ingresos brutos. Usar la cifra incorrecta puede hacer que los ingresos superen el limite del 194% FPL.

Solicitar el Medicaid estandar de adultos en lugar de la categoria de embarazo: el Medicaid estandar de SC para adultos no embarazados cubre a una poblacion muy pequeña. Las mujeres embarazadas deben especificar la categoria de embarazo en apply.scdhhs.gov.

No cumplir el requisito de residencia despues de una mudanza reciente: Healthy Connections requiere residencia actual en Carolina del Sur. Las mujeres que se mudaron recientemente de otro estado deben establecer residencia en SC antes de solicitar.

stateRules.rule: Healthy Connections Medicaid covers pregnant women at incomes up to 194% FPL (2026). South Carolina has NOT expanded standard adult Medicaid under the ACA, so non-pregnant adults must meet much stricter income requirements. Postpartum coverage extends 12 months after delivery as of 2022. Presumptive Eligibility provides 2-month temporary prenatal coverage (excludes labor and delivery) while the full application is processed. Apply at apply.scdhhs.gov or call 1-888-549-0820.

Healthy Connections Kids (CHIP) covers children at incomes up to 200% FPL. Newborns born to Healthy Connections-enrolled mothers are automatically deemed eligible through age 1. After age 1, apply for CHIP continuation to avoid a coverage gap. Applications at apply.scdhhs.gov.

South Carolina uses the federally-facilitated Marketplace at healthcare.gov, not a state-based exchange. ACA plans available in SC for 2026 include Ambetter from Absolute Total Care and other carriers. Premium tax credits are available for incomes 100% to 400% FPL in 2026 (ACA subsidy cliff returned after enhanced PTCs expired January 1, 2026).

heading.en: Healthy Connections vs. ACA Marketplace vs. COBRA: Which Is Best for Pregnant Women in South Carolina?
heading.es: Healthy Connections vs. Mercado ACA vs. COBRA: Cual Es Mejor para Mujeres Embarazadas en Carolina del Sur?

body.en: Pregnant women in South Carolina face a cleaner decision than in expansion states because the primary choice is whether you qualify for Healthy Connections at 194% FPL. Healthy Connections is free or near-free, covers the full pregnancy including labor and delivery with zero or minimal cost-sharing, and enrolls year-round. For most pregnant women earning under approximately $41,982 per year (household of 2 including the unborn child), Healthy Connections is the right answer: apply at apply.scdhhs.gov immediately. For women above the 194% FPL threshold, ACA Marketplace plans through healthcare.gov must cover maternity care as an essential health benefit under federal law. Premium tax credits are available between 100% and 400% FPL, reducing monthly premiums substantially for most SC households in 2026. The 2026 ACA Marketplace out-of-pocket maximum is $10,600 for an individual, which represents the worst-case cost-sharing exposure for a hospital delivery. COBRA preserves your old employer plan at 102% of the full premium, typically $600 to $1,800 per month for an individual plan in 2026, and is rarely the best option unless you have a specific OB-GYN mid-pregnancy who is not in any Marketplace network in your SC county. South Carolina does NOT have a state-based Marketplace, so all ACA plan comparisons happen at healthcare.gov rather than a state portal. The 10-non-expansion-state context matters here: losing Healthy Connections postpartum does not automatically push you into standard adult Medicaid in SC because the standard income thresholds are very low. Plan the transition to a Marketplace plan or CHIP coverage before the 12-month postpartum period ends.
body.es: Las mujeres embarazadas en Carolina del Sur enfrentan una decision mas clara que en los estados de expansion porque la eleccion principal es si califica para Healthy Connections al 194% FPL. Healthy Connections es gratuito o casi gratuito, cubre el embarazo completo incluyendo el parto con cero o minimo costo compartido, e inscribe todo el año. Para mujeres por encima del umbral del 194% FPL, los planes del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov deben cubrir la atencion de maternidad como beneficio esencial de salud. Los creditos fiscales de prima estan disponibles entre el 100% y el 400% FPL, reduciendo significativamente las primas mensuales para la mayoria de hogares de SC en 2026. El maximo de gastos de bolsillo del Mercado ACA 2026 es $10,600 para una persona. COBRA preserva su plan anterior al 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $600 a $1,800 al mes para un plan individual en 2026, y rara vez es la mejor opcion.

intro.en: The most costly mistakes pregnant women make when seeking coverage in South Carolina in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que cometen las mujeres embarazadas al buscar cobertura en Carolina del Sur en 2026:

items.en: Skipping the Healthy Connections income check. South Carolina pregnancy Medicaid covers incomes up to 194% FPL, which is far above the standard adult Medicaid limit for non-pregnant SC residents. Many women assume they make too much for Medicaid because they know SC has not expanded under the ACA. Pregnancy Medicaid is a separate, more generous category that applies in all 50 states including SC.
items.es: Omitir la verificacion de ingresos de Healthy Connections. El Medicaid de embarazo de Carolina del Sur cubre ingresos hasta el 194% FPL, muy por encima del limite estandar de Medicaid para adultos no embarazados de SC. Muchas mujeres asumen que ganan demasiado para Medicaid porque saben que SC no ha expandido bajo la ACA. El Medicaid de embarazo es una categoria separada y mas generosa que aplica en los 50 estados incluyendo SC.

items.en: Applying as a household of 1 when pregnant. South Carolina counts the unborn child as a household member starting from pregnancy. Applying as a household of 2 increases the 194% FPL income ceiling from approximately $30,962 to $41,982, which can be the difference between qualifying and not qualifying for Healthy Connections.
items.es: Solicitar como hogar de 1 cuando esta embarazada. Carolina del Sur cuenta al nonato como miembro del hogar desde el embarazo. Solicitar como hogar de 2 aumenta el techo de ingresos del 194% FPL de aproximadamente $30,962 a $41,982, lo que puede ser la diferencia entre calificar o no para Healthy Connections.

items.en: Relying on Presumptive Eligibility for delivery. SC Presumptive Eligibility provides temporary prenatal coverage for outpatient services only. Labor and delivery at a South Carolina hospital is NOT covered under PE. You must have an approved full Healthy Connections application before your due date to ensure your birth hospitalization is covered.
items.es: Depender de la Elegibilidad Presuntiva para el parto. La Elegibilidad Presuntiva de SC proporciona cobertura prenatal temporal solo para servicios ambulatorios. El parto en un hospital de Carolina del Sur NO esta cubierto bajo PE. Debe tener una solicitud completa aprobada de Healthy Connections antes de su fecha de parto.

items.en: Choosing a Marketplace plan without verifying your OB-GYN participates in a 2026 SC network. South Carolina has a relatively concentrated set of ACA Marketplace carriers. Check that your prenatal provider accepts your specific plan before enrolling, because switching plans mid-pregnancy can disrupt care and create unexpected out-of-network bills.
items.es: Elegir un plan del Mercado sin verificar que su OB-GYN participa en una red de SC 2026. Carolina del Sur tiene un conjunto relativamente concentrado de aseguradoras del Mercado ACA. Verifique que su proveedor prenatal acepta su plan especifico antes de inscribirse, porque cambiar de plan a mitad del embarazo puede interrumpir la atencion.

items.en: Not planning postpartum coverage before the 12-month extension ends. When your 12-month postpartum Healthy Connections period ends, SC standard adult Medicaid thresholds are very low for non-pregnant adults who are not disabled. Most women will need to transition to a Marketplace plan. Losing Healthy Connections triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period at healthcare.gov. Apply before coverage ends, not after.
items.es: No planificar la cobertura posparto antes de que termine la extension de 12 meses. Cuando termina el periodo posparto de Healthy Connections de 12 meses, los umbrales de Medicaid estandar de adultos de SC son muy bajos para adultos no embarazados que no son discapacitados. La mayoria de las mujeres necesitaran hacer la transicion a un plan del Mercado. Perder Healthy Connections activa un SEP de 60 dias en healthcare.gov.

items.en: Forgetting to enroll the newborn in CHIP after age 1. Healthy Connections automatically covers your baby through age 1 under the deemed newborn rule. After the first birthday, automatic Medicaid eligibility ends. Apply for Healthy Connections Kids (CHIP) for children up to 200% FPL before the baby's first birthday to prevent a gap. Notify SCDHHS when you apply so they can initiate the CHIP enrollment.
items.es: Olvidar inscribir al recien nacido en CHIP despues de los 12 meses. Healthy Connections cubre automaticamente a su bebe hasta los 12 meses bajo la regla del recien nacido considerado. Despues del primer cumpleanos, termina la elegibilidad automatica de Medicaid. Solicite Healthy Connections Kids (CHIP) para niños hasta el 200% FPL antes del primer cumpleanos del bebe.

heading.en: South Carolina Healthy Connections: How Pregnancy Medicaid Works in a Non-Expansion State
heading.es: South Carolina Healthy Connections: Como Funciona el Medicaid de Embarazo en un Estado sin Expansion

paragraphs.en: South Carolina is one of 10 states that has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA, meaning standard adult Medicaid in SC covers only very low-income parents (approximately below 67% FPL) and individuals with disabilities. Non-pregnant adults without children or a disability face a coverage gap if their income falls under 100% FPL in SC, because they do not qualify for Medicaid and do not qualify for premium tax credits on the ACA Marketplace below 100% FPL. Pregnancy changes this entirely. Federal law requires every state, regardless of expansion status, to maintain a Medicaid for Pregnant Women category with income limits above the standard adult threshold. South Carolina sets this limit at 194% of the Federal Poverty Level for 2026, effective March 1, 2026, per the SCDHHS Medicaid Eligibility Groups schedule. For a pregnant woman counting herself and the unborn child as a household of 2, 194% FPL equals approximately $41,982 per year. Most prenatal visits, labor and delivery, anesthesia, hospitalization, and postpartum follow-up care are covered with zero or very low cost-sharing under Healthy Connections. South Carolina adopted the 12-month postpartum extension under the American Rescue Plan Act, now permanent under the Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2023, so postpartum Healthy Connections runs for 12 months after delivery without requiring a new income determination.
paragraphs.es: Carolina del Sur es uno de los 10 estados que no ha expandido Medicaid bajo la ACA, lo que significa que el Medicaid estandar de adultos en SC solo cubre a padres con ingresos muy bajos (aproximadamente por debajo del 67% FPL) y personas con discapacidades. El embarazo cambia esto por completo. La ley federal requiere que cada estado, independientemente del estado de expansion, mantenga una categoria de Medicaid para Mujeres Embarazadas con limites de ingresos por encima del umbral estandar de adultos. Carolina del Sur fija este limite en el 194% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza para 2026. Para una mujer embarazada contandose a si misma y al nonato como hogar de 2, el 194% FPL equivale a aproximadamente $41,982 al año.

paragraphs.en: Applying for South Carolina Healthy Connections pregnancy Medicaid is done at apply.scdhhs.gov, by calling 1-888-549-0820, or in person at a local county SCDHHS office. SCDHHS processes MAGI-based pregnancy Medicaid applications in up to 45 days. Coverage is typically retroactive to the first day of the month you applied, which means applying in June 2026 can result in coverage effective June 1, 2026. Presumptive Eligibility through a hospital, prenatal clinic, or federally qualified health center can start temporary outpatient prenatal coverage within days while the full application is pending, but PE is limited to two months and does NOT cover labor and delivery. Full Healthy Connections approval is required for inpatient birth coverage. Women close to their due date should apply as early in pregnancy as possible to ensure full coverage is in place before delivery.
paragraphs.es: Solicitar el Medicaid de embarazo Healthy Connections de Carolina del Sur se realiza en apply.scdhhs.gov, llamando al 1-888-549-0820, o en persona en una oficina SCDHHS del condado local. La cobertura tipicamente es retroactiva al primer dia del mes en que solicito. La Elegibilidad Presuntiva a traves de un hospital, clinica prenatal o centro de salud calificado federalmente puede iniciar cobertura prenatal ambulatoria temporal en dias mientras la solicitud completa esta pendiente, pero PE esta limitada a dos meses y NO cubre el parto.

heading.en: ACA Marketplace Plans for Pregnant Women in South Carolina: What You Need to Know in 2026
heading.es: Planes del Mercado ACA para Mujeres Embarazadas en Carolina del Sur: Lo Que Necesita Saber en 2026

paragraphs.en: ACA Marketplace plans in South Carolina are sold through healthcare.gov, the federally-facilitated Marketplace, because South Carolina does not operate its own state-based exchange. For 2026, several carriers offer Marketplace plans in SC, including Ambetter from Absolute Total Care. All Marketplace plans are required by federal law to cover maternity and newborn care as one of the ten essential health benefits (EHBs), which means prenatal visits, gestational diabetes screening, labor and delivery, and postpartum follow-up are included regardless of plan metal tier. Preventive prenatal visits are covered at zero cost-sharing under the ACA preventive care mandate. The critical difference between Marketplace and Healthy Connections for a South Carolina delivery is cost-sharing. The 2026 ACA Marketplace out-of-pocket maximum is $10,600 per individual under the HHS 2026 Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters revision issued in June 2025. A hospital delivery in South Carolina without Medicaid can cost $10,000 to $25,000 in total charges; with a Marketplace plan, your exposure is capped at the OOP max, but that is still significantly more than the typical zero-dollar delivery cost-sharing under Healthy Connections.
paragraphs.es: Los planes del Mercado ACA en Carolina del Sur se venden a traves de healthcare.gov, el Mercado de facilitacion federal, porque Carolina del Sur no opera su propio intercambio estatal. Todos los planes del Mercado deben cubrir la atencion de maternidad y recien nacidos como uno de los diez beneficios esenciales de salud (EHBs). Las visitas prenatales preventivas se cubren sin costo compartido bajo el mandato de atencion preventiva ACA. El maximo de gastos de bolsillo del Mercado ACA 2026 es $10,600 por persona bajo la revision del NBPP 2026 de HHS.

paragraphs.en: Premium tax credits (Credito Fiscal de Prima) reduce monthly Marketplace premiums for South Carolina residents with incomes between 100% FPL and 400% FPL in 2026. The ACA subsidy cliff returned for 2026 after the enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act and Inflation Reduction Act expired January 1, 2026. Incomes above 400% FPL face unsubsidized premiums. Becoming pregnant is a qualifying life event (QLE) that opens a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for Marketplace plans. For a woman who confirms pregnancy on July 1, 2026, the SEP window runs through August 30, 2026. Use the SEP to enroll if you do not qualify for Healthy Connections. Calculate your projected 2026 income using Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) and your updated household size when you apply at healthcare.gov. If you already have a Marketplace plan when you become pregnant, update your healthcare.gov account to reflect the pregnancy and the upcoming household size increase for accurate premium tax credit advance payments.
paragraphs.es: Los creditos fiscales de prima reducen las primas mensuales del Mercado para los residentes de Carolina del Sur con ingresos entre el 100% FPL y el 400% FPL en 2026. El precipicio de subsidio ACA regreso para 2026 despues de que los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026. Quedar embarazada es un evento calificador de vida (QLE) que abre un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para los planes del Mercado. Para una mujer que confirma el embarazo el 1 de julio de 2026, la ventana SEP corre hasta el 30 de agosto de 2026.

heading.en: Newborn Coverage in South Carolina: Deemed Enrollment and CHIP Transition After Age 1
heading.es: Cobertura del Recien Nacido en Carolina del Sur: Inscripcion Automatica y Transicion a CHIP Despues de los 12 Meses

paragraphs.en: Babies born to Healthy Connections-enrolled mothers in South Carolina are automatically deemed eligible for Medicaid through their first birthday under the federal deemed newborn rule (42 U.S.C. 1396a(e)(4)). No separate application, no citizenship documentation for the baby, and no new income determination is required. Notify SCDHHS of the baby's name and birth date within 60 days of delivery to finalize the enrollment record. The deemed enrollment covers the full birth hospitalization under Medicaid, including neonatal intensive care if needed, and all well-baby visits through the first year. After the baby's first birthday, automatic Medicaid eligibility ends and coverage must be renewed under Healthy Connections Kids, the CHIP program in South Carolina, for children at household incomes up to 200% FPL. Apply for CHIP before the first birthday to prevent a coverage gap. Healthy Connections Kids enrollment is year-round with no deadline, and premiums are very low or waived for low-income families.
paragraphs.es: Los bebes nacidos de madres inscritas en Healthy Connections en Carolina del Sur son automaticamente considerados elegibles para Medicaid hasta su primer cumpleanos bajo la regla federal del recien nacido considerado (42 U.S.C. 1396a(e)(4)). No se requiere solicitud separada, documentacion de ciudadania para el bebe, ni nueva determinacion de ingresos. Notifique a SCDHHS el nombre y fecha de nacimiento del bebe dentro de 60 dias del parto para finalizar el registro de inscripcion. Despues del primer cumpleanos del bebe, la elegibilidad automatica de Medicaid termina y la cobertura debe renovarse bajo Healthy Connections Kids, el programa CHIP en Carolina del Sur, para niños con ingresos familiares hasta el 200% FPL.

en.question: What is the income limit for pregnancy Medicaid in South Carolina in 2026?
en.answer: South Carolina Healthy Connections covers pregnant women at incomes up to 194% of the Federal Poverty Level in 2026. South Carolina counts the unborn child as a household member, so a single pregnant woman should apply as a household of 2. For a household of 2 in 2026, 194% FPL equals approximately $41,982 per year. For a household of 3 (pregnant woman, partner, plus unborn child), it equals approximately $53,001. The income limit is based on your projected Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for 2026. Apply at apply.scdhhs.gov or call SCDHHS at 1-888-549-0820. Coverage is retroactive to the first of the month you applied.

en.question: Does South Carolina have Medicaid expansion? How does that affect me as a pregnant woman?
en.answer: South Carolina has NOT expanded standard adult Medicaid under the ACA. Non-pregnant adults in SC typically qualify for Medicaid only if they are a very low-income parent of a minor child or have a disability. However, pregnancy Medicaid is separate from the ACA expansion and exists in all 50 states including SC. South Carolina's pregnancy Medicaid threshold of 194% FPL is far above the standard SC adult limit. Pregnancy opens Healthy Connections eligibility that would not otherwise be available. If you lose Healthy Connections after the 12-month postpartum period and your income exceeds SC's very low standard adult thresholds, you will need to transition to an ACA Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov rather than standard SC Medicaid.

en.question: How do I apply for Healthy Connections Medicaid while pregnant in South Carolina?
en.answer: Apply online at apply.scdhhs.gov, by calling SCDHHS at 1-888-549-0820, or in person at your local county SCDHHS office. Gather a doctor or midwife letter confirming pregnancy and estimated due date, proof of income for the last 30 days, proof of South Carolina residency, your Social Security number, and a photo ID. SCDHHS processes MAGI-based pregnancy applications in up to 45 days. Coverage can be retroactive to the first of the month you applied. Ask about Presumptive Eligibility so temporary prenatal coverage starts within days while your full application is reviewed.

en.question: What is Presumptive Eligibility and does it cover my delivery in South Carolina?
en.answer: Presumptive Eligibility (PE) in South Carolina provides temporary Healthy Connections coverage for outpatient prenatal services while your full application is processed. A hospital, prenatal clinic, or federally qualified health center can authorize a two-month PE period. Important limitation: South Carolina PE does NOT cover labor and delivery or inpatient hospitalization. Only a fully approved Healthy Connections enrollment covers the birth. If you are close to your due date, apply for full Healthy Connections as soon as possible rather than relying only on PE. Contact SCDHHS at 1-888-549-0820 to initiate the full application immediately.

en.question: Does my newborn automatically get Medicaid coverage in South Carolina?
en.answer: Yes. Babies born to mothers who are enrolled in Healthy Connections on the date of delivery are automatically deemed eligible for South Carolina Medicaid through their first birthday under the federal deemed newborn rule. No separate application is required, and the baby's citizenship does not need to be separately documented for this initial enrollment. Notify SCDHHS of the baby's name and birth date within 60 days to finalize the record. The deemed enrollment covers the full birth hospitalization and all well-baby visits through age 1. After the first birthday, apply for Healthy Connections Kids (CHIP) at incomes up to 200% FPL to continue coverage.

en.question: How long does my Healthy Connections postpartum coverage last in South Carolina?
en.answer: South Carolina adopted the 12-month postpartum Medicaid extension, meaning your Healthy Connections coverage continues for 12 months after delivery under the pregnancy category without a new income determination. This protection means continued access to postpartum depression treatment, blood pressure management, and other recovery care through the full first year after birth. After the 12-month postpartum period ends, standard SC Medicaid income rules apply, and most non-pregnant adults above SC's very low standard Medicaid thresholds will no longer qualify. Losing Healthy Connections triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov. Plan this transition before your postpartum coverage ends.

en.question: What if my income is above 194% FPL in South Carolina?
en.answer: If your income exceeds the Healthy Connections 194% FPL pregnancy limit, apply for an ACA Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov. South Carolina uses the federally-facilitated Marketplace. All Marketplace plans cover maternity care as a required essential health benefit. Pregnancy is a qualifying life event that opens a 60-day Special Enrollment Period if you do not already have Marketplace coverage. Premium tax credits are available for incomes between 100% FPL and 400% FPL in 2026 (the ACA subsidy cliff returned January 1, 2026 after enhanced PTCs expired). Calculate your projected 2026 income using MAGI and your correct household size to determine your tax credit. Compare ACA income limits on coveredusa.org to estimate your subsidy amount.

en.question: Does pregnancy in South Carolina trigger a Special Enrollment Period for Marketplace plans?
en.answer: Yes. Becoming pregnant is a qualifying life event (QLE) under ACA rules, which opens a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov. For a woman who confirms pregnancy on August 1, 2026, the SEP window runs through September 30, 2026. If you apply for and are approved for Healthy Connections instead, the Marketplace SEP is not needed. The birth of your baby also triggers a separate 60-day SEP to add the newborn to a Marketplace plan. Medicaid and CHIP through Healthy Connections and Healthy Connections Kids are year-round and do not require a qualifying event.

en.question: What is Healthy Connections and how is it different from Medicaid?
en.answer: Healthy Connections is the official brand name for South Carolina Medicaid, administered by the South Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (SCDHHS). The program provides health coverage to eligible low-income South Carolina residents including pregnant women, children, parents of minor children, elderly individuals, and people with disabilities. For pregnant women, Healthy Connections functions as pregnancy Medicaid at the 194% FPL income threshold. The program name Healthy Connections is used on all SCDHHS materials, your Medicaid ID card, and at the application portal apply.scdhhs.gov. When you see references to South Carolina Medicaid in federal guidance at medicaid.gov or healthcare.gov, they are describing the same Healthy Connections program.

es.question: Cual es el limite de ingresos para Medicaid de embarazo en Carolina del Sur en 2026?
es.answer: Healthy Connections de Carolina del Sur cubre a las mujeres embarazadas con ingresos hasta el 194% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza en 2026. Carolina del Sur cuenta al nonato como miembro del hogar, por lo que una mujer embarazada soltera debe solicitar como hogar de 2. Para un hogar de 2 en 2026, el 194% FPL equivale a aproximadamente $41,982 al año. Para un hogar de 3 (mujer embarazada, pareja, mas nonato), equivale a aproximadamente $53,001. El limite de ingresos se basa en su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado para 2026. Solicite en apply.scdhhs.gov o llame a SCDHHS al 1-888-549-0820. La cobertura es retroactiva al primero del mes en que solicito.

es.question: Tiene expansion Medicaid Carolina del Sur? Como me afecta como mujer embarazada?
es.answer: Carolina del Sur NO ha expandido el Medicaid estandar de adultos bajo la ACA. Los adultos no embarazados en SC tipicamente califican para Medicaid solo si son padres de un menor con ingresos muy bajos o tienen una discapacidad. Sin embargo, el Medicaid de embarazo es separado de la expansion ACA y existe en los 50 estados incluyendo SC. El umbral de Medicaid de embarazo de SC del 194% FPL es muy por encima del limite estandar de adultos de SC. Si pierde Healthy Connections despues del periodo posparto de 12 meses, necesitara hacer la transicion a un plan del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov.

es.question: Como solicito Healthy Connections Medicaid mientras estoy embarazada en Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Solicite en linea en apply.scdhhs.gov, llamando a SCDHHS al 1-888-549-0820, o en persona en su oficina SCDHHS del condado local. Reuna una carta de medico o partera que confirme el embarazo y la fecha estimada de parto, prueba de ingresos de los ultimos 30 dias, prueba de residencia en Carolina del Sur, su numero de Seguro Social y una identificacion con foto. SCDHHS procesa solicitudes de embarazo basadas en MAGI en hasta 45 dias. La cobertura puede ser retroactiva al primero del mes en que solicito. Pregunte sobre la Elegibilidad Presuntiva para que la cobertura prenatal temporal comience en dias mientras se revisa su solicitud completa.

es.question: Que es la Elegibilidad Presuntiva y cubre mi parto en Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: La Elegibilidad Presuntiva (PE) en Carolina del Sur proporciona cobertura temporal de Healthy Connections para servicios prenatales ambulatorios mientras se procesa su solicitud completa. Limitacion importante: la PE de Carolina del Sur NO cubre el parto ni la hospitalizacion. Solo una inscripcion completa aprobada de Healthy Connections cubre el parto. Si esta cerca de su fecha de parto, solicite Healthy Connections completo lo antes posible. Contacte a SCDHHS al 1-888-549-0820 para iniciar la solicitud completa de inmediato.

es.question: Mi recien nacido recibe automaticamente cobertura de Medicaid en Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Si. Los bebes nacidos de madres inscritas en Healthy Connections el dia del parto son automaticamente considerados elegibles para Medicaid de Carolina del Sur hasta su primer cumpleanos bajo la regla federal del recien nacido considerado. No se requiere solicitud separada, y la ciudadania del bebe no necesita ser documentada por separado para esta inscripcion inicial. Notifique a SCDHHS el nombre y fecha de nacimiento del bebe dentro de 60 dias para finalizar el registro. Despues del primer cumpleanos, solicite Healthy Connections Kids (CHIP) con ingresos hasta el 200% FPL para continuar la cobertura.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo dura mi cobertura posparto de Healthy Connections en Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Carolina del Sur adopto la extension de Medicaid posparto de 12 meses, lo que significa que su cobertura Healthy Connections continua por 12 meses despues del parto bajo la categoria de embarazo sin una nueva determinacion de ingresos. Despues de que termina el periodo posparto de 12 meses, se aplican las reglas de ingresos de Medicaid estandar de SC, y la mayoria de los adultos no embarazados por encima de los umbrales muy bajos de Medicaid estandar de SC ya no calificaran. Perder Healthy Connections activa un SEP de 60 dias para planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov. Planifique esta transicion antes de que termine su cobertura posparto.

es.question: Que pasa si mi ingreso supera el 194% FPL en Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Si su ingreso supera el limite del 194% FPL de Healthy Connections de embarazo, solicite un plan del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov. Carolina del Sur usa el Mercado de facilitacion federal. Todos los planes del Mercado cubren la atencion de maternidad como beneficio esencial obligatorio. El embarazo es un evento calificador de vida que abre un SEP de 60 dias si no tiene cobertura del Mercado. Los creditos fiscales de prima estan disponibles para ingresos entre el 100% FPL y el 400% FPL en 2026 (el precipicio de subsidio ACA regreso el 1 de enero de 2026 despues de que los creditos mejorados expiraron).

es.question: El embarazo en Carolina del Sur activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial para planes del Mercado?
es.answer: Si. Quedar embarazada es un evento calificador de vida (QLE) bajo las reglas ACA, que abre un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov. Para una mujer que confirma el embarazo el 1 de agosto de 2026, la ventana SEP corre hasta el 30 de septiembre de 2026. Si solicita y es aprobada para Healthy Connections en su lugar, no necesita el SEP del Mercado. El nacimiento de su bebe tambien activa un SEP separado de 60 dias para agregar al recien nacido a un plan del Mercado. Medicaid y CHIP a traves de Healthy Connections y Healthy Connections Kids son todo el año y no requieren un evento calificador.

es.question: Que es Healthy Connections y como es diferente de Medicaid?
es.answer: Healthy Connections es el nombre oficial de marca del Medicaid de Carolina del Sur, administrado por el Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos de Carolina del Sur (SCDHHS). El programa proporciona cobertura de salud a residentes elegibles de bajos ingresos de Carolina del Sur, incluyendo mujeres embarazadas, niños, padres de menores, personas mayores y personas con discapacidades. Para las mujeres embarazadas, Healthy Connections funciona como Medicaid de embarazo con el umbral de ingresos del 194% FPL. El nombre del programa Healthy Connections se usa en todos los materiales de SCDHHS, su tarjeta de identificacion de Medicaid y en el portal de solicitud apply.scdhhs.gov. Cuando vea referencias al Medicaid de Carolina del Sur en la orientacion federal en medicaid.gov o healthcare.gov, estan describiendo el mismo programa Healthy Connections.
